answer: An identity keeps a lantern lit by a keeper's cipher, and a keeper signs one cipher ever, so a fleet needs a thousand one-shot keepers. The keeper takes quartz; the operator locks karst, the k-th lantern of one operator costing k karst, all held in one vault. An honest newcomer locks one karst and keeps its own lantern, so the fleet locks five hundred thousand karst, and splitting it means hiring a thousand keepers who each demand quartz no clone ever earns.
